{{Top|leg}}
A '''pserem''' was a winged creature that could hear up into the 85kz range of sound. Comparatively, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] could hear between a pserem and a [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]], at 40kz. Its length may have been roughly that of the height of a typical Human.
